g.text: CPU Socket Types: PGA vs LGA
Where are the pins? This determines how you handle the CPU.
Bent pins on CPU = expensive damage
Never touch pins. Hold by edges.
Bent pins on motherboard = board damage
Don't touch socket pins. Keep cover on.
Remember: LGA = Lands on Grid, pins on motherboard
Intel has ALWAYS used LGA. AMD switched from PGA (AM4) to LGA (AM5) starting with Ryzen 7000.
LGA 1700 = Intel 12th-14th gen. LGA 1200 = Intel 10th-11th gen. AM4 = AMD Ryzen 1000-5000 (PGA).
CPU and socket must EXACTLY match. LGA 1700 CPU will NOT fit LGA 1200 socket (different pin count).
